description: Participatory research on sustainable alternatives for water management in agricultural environments in a context of climate change (RADEAU) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Being anxious to participate in the adaptation of agricultural businesses in a context of climate change, MAPAQ has commissioned a study to better identify the challenges current and future of water management. The mandate involved drawing up a portrait of needs. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Watershed, Climate change, Sustainable development, Surface water, Groundwater. It offers 16 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML, PDF, SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
